content: The role of telehealth in diabetes management, as highlighted by the American Diabetes Association (ADA), includes several key features: 1. Video Consultations: These enable direct, face-to-face interactions between patients and healthcare providers through virtual platforms. This approach helps build trust between the patient and provider while allowing for real-time feedback on the patient’s condition and management plan. 2. Remote Patient Monitoring: This feature allows healthcare providers to continuously monitor critical patient metrics, such as blood glucose levels, in real-time. Importantly, this can be done without requiring the patient to attend in-person visits, making it a convenient and efficient method for ongoing care. 3. Digital Communications: This includes the use of text messaging and email to maintain consistent communication with patients. These tools provide patients with ongoing support and guidance outside of their scheduled appointments, ensuring they have access to assistance whenever needed.
